messages:
sarah (solutions): Quick sync — Halloway POC cutover timeline. They want a dry-run on Tue 4/14 and a canary go-live Wed 4/15. Need owners for staging creds, rollout plan, and success criteria.
aj (sales): FYI they committed to the Tue window. Elaine, can SE own test dataset + acceptance script?
elaine (se): I can do dataset + smoke script. Will post the test curl + sample payload by EOD today.
rob (eng): Who owns the model pin and canary routing? We need a pinned v1.2.3 container and a fallback to smaller model if latency spikes.
sarah (solutions): Rob owns the model pin + rollout config. Rob — can you add a canary percentage and automatic rollback threshold?
rob (eng): Yep. Plan: 10% canary for first hour, 50% if stable for 30m, full roll after 2 hours. Rollback if p95 latency > 600ms or error rate > 1%. Will add to rollout config today.
omar (sre): Need to provision Halloway staging IPs for allowlist and a short maintenance window for load tests. Send me the CIDR range.
elaine (se): Halloway staging CIDR: 10.15.8.0/24. Also will need staging API key with read/write for embeddings and generation.
omar (sre): Got it. I'll request the IAM role and add to the network allowlist; aim to finish by tomorrow noon.
mike (product): Success criteria from product: functional e2e (no more than 3 blocking defects), perf targets p95 < 600ms, embedding recall >= 0.82 on our labeled set, and cost per 1k tokens < $0.90 for typical workload. Can SE confirm dataset will cover recall checks?
elaine (se): Yes, dataset includes 1200 labeled examples for recall/regression checks. I'll run the eval and post results into the tracker.
aj (sales): Also need an integration deliverables list for Halloway ops: webhook schema, retry semantics, auth header format, and SLA for delivery.
sarah (solutions): I'll draft the deliverables doc now. Quick ask — QA needs a staging endpoint and a short-lived key to run concurrent sessions. Can we provide one?
omar (sre): I can create a short-lived key (24h) for the dry-run and a longer one for canary. Will post details in the secure channel when created.
rob (eng): Code review ping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pulls/412 — contains the canary router and rollback hooks. @sarah @elaine please review for SE edge cases.
elaine (se): Reviewing now. Leaving a couple inline comments re: header passthrough and trace IDs.
sarah (solutions): Thanks — will review by EOD. If both clear, Rob can merge and we schedule the canary rollout.
omar (sre): One more infra ask: load test ramp plan? I suggest 100 -> 1k concurrent over 20m, run for 30m at peak. Approve?
mike (product): Approve the ramp. Capture SLA burn and any transient 5xxs in the post-mortem.
aj (sales): I'll line up Halloway contacts for Tue and Wed windows and confirm dry-run scope: smoke + 100 concurrent gen requests.
sarah (solutions): Great. Checklist for owners: 
- Elaine: test dataset + acceptance script (due today)
- Rob: canary config + PR merged (due EOD)
- Omar: staging allowlist + keys (by tomorrow noon)
- Mike: success criteria documented (done)
- AJ: customer scheduling + runbook (by tomorrow)

If anyone has blockers call them out now. Otherwise we'll treat this as the working plan. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for 2026-04-15 15:00 UTC (10% traffic).
sarah (solutions): Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post final runbook in #sales before EOD and tag the secure channel with creds once Omar posts them.
aj (sales): Thanks — team standing by for dry-run.
